title: What are the “New” Seven Wonders of the World?
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

keywords.def: something that causes great admiration because of its beauty, scale, or remarkable achievement
officially put forward as a candidate for selection or recognition
the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation, responsible for protecting world heritage sites
the traditions, monuments, and values passed down from previous generations as part of a culture’s history
based on equal participation and voting by ordinary people rather than by experts or officials
the expression of disapproval or the identification of faults in something
prolonged public disagreement or debate about something, often involving strong opposing opinions

sentences.en: Thousands of years ago, Ancient Greek travellers created a list of the most extraordinary sights they encountered: the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
sentences.zh: 几千年前，古希腊旅行者列出了一份他们见过的最奇妙景点的清单，这就是古代世界七大奇迹。

sentences.en: These included places like the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, the Lighthouse of Alexandria, and the Colossus of Rhodes.
sentences.zh: 其中包括巴比伦空中花园、亚历山大灯塔和罗德岛太阳神巨像等地方。

sentences.en: Today though, only one still survives: the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 然而今天，只有一个仍然幸存：埃及的吉萨大金字塔。

sentences.en: So, in the early 2000s, a huge international campaign called the “New Seven Wonders of the World” aimed to create a modern list of wonders.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2000年代初，一项名为“新世界七大奇迹”的大型国际活动旨在创造一份现代的世界奇迹清单。

sentences.en: Some governments launched campaigns encouraging citizens to vote for their country’s monument.
sentences.zh: 一些政府发起运动，鼓励公民为自己国家的古迹投票。

sentences.en: Critics argued that countries with larger populations had an unfair advantage.
sentences.zh: 批评人士认为，人口更多的国家具有不公平的优势。

sentences.en: And UNESCO, the United Nations organisation responsible for protecting world heritage sites, was not involved in the project.
sentences.zh: 而负责保护世界遗产的联合国机构——UNESCO，并没有参与这个项目。

sentences.en: So today, I want to explore the story behind the New Seven Wonders of the World.
sentences.zh: 所以今天，我想探讨“新世界七大奇迹”背后的故事。

sentences.en: What are they? Why were they chosen? And do they really deserve the title of “wonder”?
sentences.zh: 它们是什么？它们是如何被选出来的？它们真的配得上“奇迹”这个称号吗？

sentences.en: And we will do all of this while learning some new vocabulary and practicing your English listening comprehension.
sentences.zh: 我们将在了解一些新词汇和练习英语听力理解的同时，完成所有这些内容。

sentences.en: The original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World came from the writings of ancient Greek travelers and historians.
sentences.zh: 最初的古代世界七大奇迹源自古希腊旅行者和历史学家的著作。

sentences.en: As Greeks traveled around the Mediterranean and the Middle East, they wrote about the most extraordinary things they saw.
sentences.zh: 当希腊人在地中海和中东各地旅行时，他们写下了他们所看到的非凡事物。

sentences.en: The Ancient Greek word for these things was the ‘ Theamata ‘, which I probably pronounced wrong, but ‘ Theamata ‘ roughly means “things worth seeing “.
sentences.zh: 古希腊语中称这些东西为“Theamata”（我可能发音不对），但“Theamata”大致意思是“值得一看的事物”。

sentences.en: So these wonders were basically ancient tourist attractions.
sentences.zh: 所以这些奇迹基本上就是古代的旅游景点。

sentences.en: They were places that Greek travelers believed were worth visiting.
sentences.zh: 它们是希腊旅行者认为值得一游的地方。

sentences.en: The list changed slightly over time, but several monuments regularly appeared in ancient Greek writings.
sentences.zh: 这份名单随着时间推移略有变化，但有几个古迹经常出现在古希腊的著作中。

sentences.en: There was the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt, which was the enormous tomb built for a pharaoh thousands of years ago.
sentences.zh: 埃及有吉萨大金字塔，那是几千年前为法老建造的宏伟陵墓。

sentences.en: There were the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, which may or may not have actually existed.
sentences.zh: 还有巴比伦空中花园，它到底存不存在可能还要打个问号。

sentences.en: There was the Colossus of Rhodes, which was a giant bronze statue that stood near a harbor in Greece.
sentences.zh: 还有罗德岛太阳神巨像，那是矗立在希腊港口附近的巨大青铜雕像。

sentences.en: And also the Lighthouse of Alexandria, which guided ships safely into the ancient city of Alexandria.
sentences.zh: 以及亚历山大灯塔，它引导船只安全驶入古城亚历山大。

sentences.en: These places were considered wonders because of their size or their beauty or their engineering.
sentences.zh: 这些地方之所以被认为是奇迹，是因为它们的规模、美感或工程技术。

sentences.en: The ancient wonders reflected the lives of these educated Greek people living and traveling around the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 古代奇迹反映了这些在地中海生活和旅行的有文化的希腊人的生活。

sentences.en: They knew little about East Asia or Sub-Saharan Africa, and they knew nothing about the Americas.
sentences.zh: 他们对东亚或撒哈拉以南非洲知之甚少，对美洲则一无所知。

sentences.en: So all of these wonders were in their small world.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些奇迹都在他们狭小的世界里。

sentences.en: Over time, though, most of these ancient wonders disappeared.
sentences.zh: 然而随着时间推移，大多数古代奇迹都消失了。

sentences.en: Earthquakes destroyed some. Wars damaged others.
sentences.zh: 地震摧毁了一些，战争损坏了另一些。

sentences.en: Only one still survives: the Great Pyramid of Giza.
sentences.zh: 只有一个幸存至今：吉萨大金字塔。

sentences.en: Around the year 2000, an idea for a New Seven Wonders of the World list began to develop.
sentences.zh: 2000年前后，“新世界七大奇迹”名单的构想开始形成。

sentences.en: An organization called the New7Wonders Foundation was founded.
sentences.zh: 一个名为“新七大奇迹基金会”的组织成立了。

sentences.en: This project was created by Bernard Werber from Switzerland, who wanted to create a modern version of the ancient wonders list.
sentences.zh: 这个项目由来自瑞士的伯纳德·韦伯创建，他想创造一个古代奇迹名单的现代版本。

sentences.en: He believed that the world needed a new list of wonders that reflected the achievements of different places around the world, not just the ancient Mediterranean region.
sentences.zh: 他认为世界需要一份新的奇迹名单，反映世界各地不同地方的成就，而不仅仅是古代地中海地区。

sentences.en: This new version of a list would be decided democratically by ordinary people voting on monuments or sites that still exist.
sentences.zh: 这份名单的新版本将由普通民众对仍然存在的纪念碑或遗址进行民主投票来决定。

sentences.en: More than 100 famous monuments and historical sites were nominated from around the world.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的100多个著名古迹和历史遗址被提名。

sentences.en: These included castles and temples. There were statues, pyramids, and ancient cities.
sentences.zh: 其中包括城堡和寺庙，也有雕像、金字塔和古城。

sentences.en: People could vote online or by phone for the monuments they believed deserved to be one of the New 7 Wonders.
sentences.zh: 人们可以通过网络或电话为你认为配得上“新世界七大奇迹”之一的古迹投票。

sentences.en: And this campaign became enormous. The organizers claim that tens of millions of people participated worldwide.
sentences.zh: 这项活动变得规模空前。组织者声称全球有数千万人参与。

sentences.en: Governments and tourism boards and media organizations all became involved.
sentences.zh: 政府、旅游局和媒体机构都参与其中。

sentences.en: Some countries launched major advertising campaigns encouraging citizens to vote for their national monument.
sentences.zh: 一些国家发起大型广告活动，鼓励公民为本国古迹投票。

sentences.en: The final results were announced on July 7th, 2007, written numerically as 07/07/07, for the Seven Wonders.
sentences.zh: 最终结果于2007年7月7日公布，数字写出来就是07/07/07，对应七大奇迹。

sentences.en: The winners were the Great Wall of China, Petra in Jordan, Machu Picchu in Peru, Chichén Itzá in Mexico, the Colosseum in Italy, the Taj Mahal in India, and Christ the Redeemer in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 获胜者是中国的万里长城、约旦的佩特拉古城、秘鲁马丘比丘、墨西哥奇琴伊察、意大利罗马斗兽场、印度的泰姬陵和巴西的基督救世主雕像。

sentences.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza was also given honorary status as the only surviving ancient wonder.
sentences.zh: 吉萨大金字塔也被赋予了荣誉地位，作为唯一幸存的古代奇迹。

sentences.en: But despite the excitement around this campaign, there was also a lot of confusion about who exactly was behind it.
sentences.zh: 但尽管这场活动令人兴奋，对于究竟是谁在背后主导，也存在很多困惑。

sentences.en: In fact, there’s still confusion about it today.
sentences.zh: 事实上，直到今天这种困惑依然存在。

sentences.en: Many people assume this project was connected to UNESCO.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为这个项目与UNESCO有关。

sentences.en: UNESCO is the United Nations organization responsible for protecting important historical and cultural sites.
sentences.zh: UNESCO是负责保护重要历史和文化遗址的联合国机构。

sentences.en: But UNESCO was not involved. They had no connection to the New Seven Wonders campaign.
sentences.zh: 但UNESCO并没有参与。他们与新七大奇迹活动没有任何关系。

sentences.en: In fact, UNESCO publicly stated that cultural heritage should not be decided through voting or commercial campaigns.
sentences.zh: 事实上，UNESCO公开表示，文化遗产不应该通过投票或商业活动来决定。

sentences.en: People were also uncomfortable with the fact that the New7Wonders Foundation was a private organization.
sentences.zh: 人们也对新七大奇迹基金会是一个私人组织感到不安。

sentences.en: The distinction between UNESCO heritage sites and the New Seven Wonders is important.
sentences.zh: UNESCO遗产地与新世界七大奇迹之间的区别很重要。

sentences.en: They’re not the same thing. UNESCO selects its heritage sites based on the historical and cultural significance of the site, while the New Seven Wonders were chosen through public voting and media campaigns.
sentences.zh: 它们不是一回事。UNESCO根据遗址的历史和文化重要性来选择其遗产地，而新世界七大奇迹则是通过公众投票和媒体活动选出的。

sentences.en: Let’s take a deeper look at each of the wonders, starting with the Great Wall of China.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入了解每一个奇迹，从中国的万里长城开始。

sentences.en: I think the Great Wall of China is one of the most recognizable structures on the planet.
sentences.zh: 我认为万里长城是地球上辨识度最高的建筑之一。

sentences.en: I’m sure you all know what it is, but if you don’t… it’s a large wall.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们都知道它是什么，但如果你不知道……它就是一堵大墙。

sentences.en: The Great Wall was constructed over many centuries by different Chinese dynasties.
sentences.zh: 长城是由中国不同朝代历时数百年修建的。

sentences.en: Some early sections were built more than two thousand years ago, while later parts were expanded during the Ming dynasty between the fourteenth and seventeenth centuries.
sentences.zh: 一些早期地段修建于两千多年前，而后期部分则在明朝十四至十七世纪期间进行了扩建。

sentences.en: Rather than being one continuous wall, it’s probably better to think about the Great Wall as a network of different walls and watchtowers and fortresses and defensive barriers which stretch all across northern China.
sentences.zh: 与其说长城是一堵连绵不断的墙，不如把它想象成由各种城墙、瞭望塔、堡垒和防御工事组成的网络，绵延整个中国北方。

sentences.en: Altogether, the Great Wall is over a thousand kilometers long.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，长城全长超过一万公里。

sentences.en: The main purpose of the wall was defense.
sentences.zh: 长城的主要目的是防御。

sentences.en: Chinese rulers wanted protection against invasions and raids from groups living to the north, particularly the nomadic tribes that were living on the Mongolian Steppe.
sentences.zh: 中国统治者希望防范来自北方群体的入侵和袭击，特别是生活在蒙古草原上的游牧部落。

sentences.en: The wall helped soldiers monitor borders and slow down enemy attacks.
sentences.zh: 长城帮助士兵监控边界并延缓敌人的进攻。

sentences.en: Building such an enormous structure required a lot of labor, a lot of money, and really difficult organization.
sentences.zh: 建造这样一个庞大的结构需要大量的劳动力、大量的资金和极其困难的组织工作。

sentences.en: So the wall was also used to demonstrate the strength of an emperor, the strength of the Chinese state.
sentences.zh: 因此长城也被用来展示皇帝的力量、中国国家的力量。

sentences.en: And today, the Great Wall still has a lot of cultural significance in China itself.
sentences.zh: 而今天，长城在中国本土仍然具有很高的文化意义。

sentences.en: There is also mystery and myths around the Great Wall.
sentences.zh: 围绕长城也有许多神秘和传说。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most famous myth is that it can be seen from space with the naked eye, but this is not necessarily true under normal conditions.
sentences.zh: 也许最著名的传说就是它可以用肉眼从太空看到，但在正常条件下这并不一定属实。

sentences.en: Few human construction projects match the size or the ambition of the Great Wall, which I think makes it an obvious choice to be on the New Wonders list.
sentences.zh: 很少有人类建筑项目能与长城的规模或宏伟相提并论，我认为这使它成为入选新奇迹名单的不二之选。

sentences.en: Next up is Petra, an ancient city hidden among the desert mountains of modern-day Jordan in the Middle East.
sentences.zh: 接下来是佩特拉，这是一座隐藏在现代中东约旦沙漠山脉中的古城。

sentences.en: Petra is famous for its buildings carved directly into pink and red sandstone cliffs.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉以其直接雕刻在粉红色和红色砂岩悬崖上的建筑而闻名。

sentences.en: It was built by the Nabataeans, an Arab civilization that became wealthy through trade more than 2,000 years ago.
sentences.zh: 它由纳巴泰人建造，这是一个在2000多年前通过贸易发家致富的阿拉伯文明。

sentences.en: The city was located at an important location.
sentences.zh: 这座城市地理位置重要。

sentences.en: It connected Arabia to Egypt and the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 它将阿拉伯半岛与埃及和地中海连接起来。

sentences.en: Merchants traveling through the desert carried valuable goods like spices and precious metals, and Petra became rich by controlling these trade routes.
sentences.zh: 穿过沙漠的商人携带香料和贵金属等贵重物品，佩特拉通过控制这些贸易路线而变得富有。

sentences.en: One of the most famous structures in Petra is called The Treasury, which is a huge carved facade that appears dramatically at the end of a canyon.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉最著名的建筑之一被称为“卡兹尼宝库”，这是一座巨大的雕刻立面，在峡谷尽头戏剧性地展现出来。

sentences.en: The Nabataeans were highly skilled engineers.
sentences.zh: 纳巴泰人是高度熟练的工程师。

sentences.en: They developed systems to collect and store and transport water.
sentences.zh: 他们开发了收集、储存和输送水的系统。

sentences.en: Without this technology, without these systems, a city like Petra could never survive in the hot desert conditions of the Middle East.
sentences.zh: 没有这项技术，没有这些系统，像佩特拉这样的城市绝不可能在中东炎热的沙漠环境中生存下来。

sentences.en: Over time, Petra declined, and eventually much of it was abandoned.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，佩特拉走向衰落，最终大部分被废弃。

sentences.en: For a long time, Petra remained relatively unknown outside of the region.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间里，佩特拉在该地区之外相对不为人知。

sentences.en: Then in 1812, a Swiss explorer named Johann Ludwig Burckhardt introduced Petra to the wider world.
sentences.zh: 然后在1812年，一位名叫约翰·路德维希·伯克哈特的瑞士探险家将佩特拉介绍给了更广阔的世界。

sentences.en: He secretly traveled there in disguise and then publicly told stories about a lost city in the desert to European newspapers, and this story became really popular.
sentences.zh: 他伪装后秘密旅行到那里，然后公开向欧洲报纸讲述了沙漠中失落之城的故事，这个故事变得非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: Archeologists continue to discover new things in Petra today, and actually large parts of the ancient city may still be unexplored.
sentences.zh: 考古学家今天仍在佩特拉发现新事物，实际上这座古城的大部分可能仍未被探索。

sentences.en: There’s still a lot to discover there. I think Petra is a great candidate to be one of the New Seven Wonders.
sentences.zh: 那里还有很多东西有待发现。我认为佩特拉是成为新世界七大奇迹的绝佳候选者。

sentences.en: It combines many things that people associate with being a wonder.
sentences.zh: 它结合了人们联想到“奇迹”的许多因素。

sentences.en: It has incredible history. It’s ancient.
sentences.zh: 它有着难以置信的历史。它是古老的。

sentences.en: Amazing, beautiful architecture and engineering skills.
sentences.zh: 令人惊叹、美丽绝伦的建筑和工程技能。

sentences.en: And it’s also mysterious… this incredible feat of architecture from thousands of years ago, which was then abandoned… is just mysterious.
sentences.zh: 而且它也很神秘……这座数千年前令人惊叹的建筑壮举随后被废弃……本身就很神秘。

sentences.en: The next wonder I think has some similarities.
sentences.zh: 我认为接下来的这个奇迹有一些相似之处。

sentences.en: It’s Machu Picchu, the famous Incan city high in the mountains of Peru.
sentences.zh: 它是马丘比丘，秘鲁高山上的著名印加城市。

sentences.en: It’s high in the mountains, surrounded by green peaks and often covered in mist.
sentences.zh: 它高耸于群山之中，被青翠的山峰环绕，经常笼罩在薄雾之中。

sentences.en: Machu Picchu was built in the fifteenth century, I think, during the height of the Inca Empire.
sentences.zh: 我想马丘比丘建于十五世纪，正值印加帝国的鼎盛时期。

sentences.en: This was the largest empire in the Americas before the arrival of Europeans.
sentences.zh: 这是欧洲人到来之前美洲最大的帝国。

sentences.en: The Incas controlled territory across much of West and South America.
sentences.zh: 印加人控制了西美洲和南美洲大部分地区的领土。

sentences.en: And they were great engineers and builders, despite the fact they lacked some really important technology.
sentences.zh: 尽管缺乏一些非常重要的技术，但他们是伟大的工程师和建造者。

sentences.en: The Incas didn’t have iron tools or wheeled transport, but they still created these incredible cities.
sentences.zh: 印加人没有铁器工具或轮式运输工具，但他们仍然创造了这些不可思议的城市。

sentences.en: Machu Picchu is more than 2,000 meters above sea level in the Andes Mountains.
sentences.zh: 马丘比丘海拔超过2000米，坐落在安第斯山脉上。

sentences.en: Transporting stone and building large temples in such a difficult environment is a challenge.
sentences.zh: 在如此困难的环境中运输石头并建造大型寺庙是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: They must have had great organization skills and lots of labor.
sentences.zh: 他们一定拥有出色的组织能力和大量的劳动力。

sentences.en: The Incas also designed the site with precision.
sentences.zh: 印加人对遗址的设计也极其精准。

sentences.en: The city included agricultural sites, temples, homes, storage areas, water channels.
sentences.zh: 这座城市包括农业区、寺庙、住宅、仓储区、水渠。

sentences.en: To be honest, historians are not completely certain why Machu Picchu was built.
sentences.zh: 说实话，历史学家并不完全确定马丘比丘为什么要建造。

sentences.en: Some believe it might have been a royal estate for an Incan emperor.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为它可能是印加皇帝的皇家庄园。

sentences.en: Others think it had more religious or ceremonial purposes.
sentences.zh: 另一些人认为它具有更多的宗教或礼仪目的。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons why Machu Picchu is still there, is because it was never discovered by the Spanish conquerors during the colonial period.
sentences.zh: 马丘比丘至今完好的原因之一，是它在殖民时期从未被西班牙征服者发现。

sentences.en: The fact that the Spanish never discovered it helped preserve much of the site.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人从未发现它的事实帮助保护了这处遗址的大部分。

sentences.en: Machu Picchu remained hidden in the mountain for centuries while most other Incan cities were destroyed or heavily altered.
sentences.zh: 马丘比丘在山中隐藏了几个世纪，而大多数其他印加城市则被摧毁或严重改变。

sentences.en: Another new wonder is Chichén Itzá, which is one of the most famous cities built by the Maya civilization in present-day Mexico.
sentences.zh: 另一个新奇迹是奇琴伊察，这是玛雅文明在现今墨西哥建造的最著名的城市之一。

sentences.en: The Maya developed advanced cities across Central America and southern Mexico.
sentences.zh: 玛雅人在中美洲和墨西哥南部发展了先进的城市。

sentences.en: They had complex writing systems, accurate calendars, and Chichén Itzá became one of their most important sites.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有复杂的书写系统、准确的历法，而奇琴伊察成为了他们最重要的遗址之一。

sentences.en: It’s best known for its enormous pyramid called El Castillo or the Temple of Kukulcan.
sentences.zh: 它最著名的标志是被称为“埃尔卡斯蒂略”或“库库尔坎神庙”的巨大金字塔。

sentences.en: The pyramid was carefully designed to align with the movement of the sun.
sentences.zh: 这座金字塔经过精心设计，以与太阳的运动保持一致。

sentences.en: So during the spring and autumn equinoxes, which is when the day and night are equal, the sunlight creates a shadow on the staircase that resembles a serpent, a snake, moving down the pyramid.
sentences.zh: 所以在春分和秋分时节，即昼夜平分的时候，阳光在阶梯上投下阴影，看起来就像一条巨蛇正在顺着金字塔往下爬。

sentences.en: This effect was connected to Kukulcan, who was a feathered serpent deity worshiped by the Maya.
sentences.zh: 这种视觉效果与库库尔坎有关，他是玛雅人崇拜的羽蛇神。

sentences.en: Chichén Itzá was also a large and complex city.
sentences.zh: 奇琴伊察也是一个庞大而复杂的城市。

sentences.en: There were temples and pyramids, also markets, ceremonial spaces, and actually one of the largest ball courts in the ancient Americas.
sentences.zh: 这里有神庙和金字塔，还有市场、礼仪空间，事实上还有美洲古代最大的球场之一。

sentences.en: The Mayans famously had their own sport, a type of ball game which has some basic similarity with sports like football.
sentences.zh: 玛雅人以拥有自己的运动而闻名，这是一种类似于现代足球的球类运动。

sentences.en: Historians believe the city was a major center for politics, trade, and religion around a thousand years ago, between the 8th and 13th centuries.
sentences.zh: 历史学家认为，这座城市大约在一千年前（即8世纪到13世纪之间）是政治、贸易和宗教的主要中心。

sentences.en: Like many ancient civilizations, the Maya experienced political instability and decline.
sentences.zh: 像许多古代文明一样，玛雅人经历了政治不稳定和衰落。

sentences.en: By the time Spanish explorers arrived in the region, Chichén Itzá had already lost much of its former power.
sentences.zh: 当西班牙探险家到达该地区时，奇琴伊察已经失去了昔日的大部分权力。

sentences.en: Today, it still attracts millions of tourists each year and is probably the most famous symbol of old civilizations in the Americas, other than Machu Picchu.
sentences.zh: 今天，它每年仍然吸引数百万游客，除了马丘比丘之外，它可能是美洲古代文明最著名的象征。

sentences.en: Moving to Europe, the Colosseum in Rome was also voted as a new wonder.
sentences.zh: 来到欧洲，罗马斗兽场也被投票选为新奇迹。

sentences.en: I think the Colosseum is the most famous surviving building from the Roman Empire.
sentences.zh: 我认为斗兽场是罗马帝国现存最著名的建筑。

sentences.en: Nearly 2,000 years ago, the Romans built an enormous amphitheater in the center of their capital city.
sentences.zh: 近2000年前，罗马人在其首都中心建造了一个巨大的圆形露天剧场。

sentences.en: It was capable of holding tens of thousands of spectators.
sentences.zh: 它能够容纳数万名观众。

sentences.en: The Colosseum was designed for public spectacles.
sentences.zh: 斗兽场是为公开奇观而设计的。

sentences.en: It was designed for crowds to gather there and watch gladiator fights or animal hunts.
sentences.zh: 它旨在让民众聚集在那里观看角斗士决斗或猎兽表演。

sentences.en: They used to host mock battles, executions, and dramatic performances inside the Colosseum.
sentences.zh: 他们过去常常在斗兽场内举办模拟海战、处决和戏剧表演。

sentences.en: Architecturally, the Colosseum was an extraordinary achievement.
sentences.zh: 在建筑上，斗兽场是一项非凡的成就。

sentences.en: The Romans had advanced engineering techniques… forms of concrete that are just as effective as modern concrete, arches, different types of support systems.
sentences.zh: 罗马人拥有先进的工程技术……其混凝土配方与现代混凝土一样有效，还有拱门和不同类型的支撑系统。

sentences.en: The Colosseum had multiple levels of seating.
sentences.zh: 斗兽场有多层座位。

sentences.en: It had underground tunnels, entrances and exits, and systems to control crowds.
sentences.zh: 它拥有地下通道、出入口以及控制人群的系统。

sentences.en: Today’s sports stadiums and arenas still use similar ideas to manage their audiences.
sentences.zh: 今天的体育场馆和竞技场仍然使用类似的想法来管理观众。

sentences.en: Many of the spectacles at the Colosseum were very violent.
sentences.zh: 斗兽场中的许多奇观都非常暴力。

sentences.en: Gladiators fought to the death, and prisoners were executed in public.
sentences.zh: 角斗士为荣誉和生命而战，罪犯则被公开处决。

sentences.en: The Colosseum has survived earthquakes, fires, theft, the collapse of the Roman Empire, and centuries of damage.
sentences.zh: 斗兽场经受住了地震、火灾、盗窃、罗马帝国的崩溃以及数百年的破坏。

sentences.en: Parts of it have fallen down, and some of its material was reused in other buildings across Rome, but a lot of the structure still stands today.
sentences.zh: 它的部分已经倒塌，一些材料被罗马的其他建筑重新利用，但大部分结构今天依然矗立。

sentences.en: By the time the New Seven Wonders vote took place, the Colosseum was already one of the world’s most recognizable historical monuments and one of the world’s most popular tourist attractions.
sentences.zh: 在新世界七大奇迹投票举行时，斗兽场已经是世界上辨识度最高历史古迹之一，也是全球最受欢迎的旅游景点之一。

sentences.en: And I think as a symbol of the Roman Empire, it was a good choice to be one of the New Seven Wonders.
sentences.zh: 我认为作为罗马帝国的象征，它是一个入选新世界七大奇迹的好选择。

sentences.en: Another monument chosen as one of the New Seven Wonders was the Taj Mahal in India.
sentences.zh: 被选为新世界七大奇迹的另一个古迹是印度的泰姬陵。

sentences.en: This is the only new wonder on the list that I have visited.
sentences.zh: 这是名单上我唯一参观过的新奇迹。

sentences.en: The Taj Mahal was built in the 17th century by the Mughal Emperor, Shah Jahan, after the death of his wife, Mumtaz Mahal.
sentences.zh: 泰姬陵由莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汉在妻子慕塔芝·玛哈尔去世后于17世纪建造。

sentences.en: The emperor was devastated by her death, and he ordered the construction of an enormous mausoleum to honor her memory.
sentences.zh: 皇帝对她的离去悲痛欲绝，下令建造一座宏伟的陵墓来纪念她。

sentences.en: Architecturally, the Taj Mahal is amazing.
sentences.zh: 在建筑上，泰姬陵令人惊叹。

sentences.en: It’s constructed from white marble and decorated with intricate carvings, calligraphy, and precious stones.
sentences.zh: 它由白大理石建造，饰有复杂的雕刻、书法和宝石。

sentences.en: It combines elements of Islamic, Persian, Indian, and Central Asian architecture.
sentences.zh: 它融合了伊斯兰、波斯、印度和中亚建筑的元素。

sentences.en: The building is famous for its near-perfect symmetry.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑以其近乎完美的对称性而闻名。

sentences.en: It looks similar wherever you look at it.
sentences.zh: 无论从哪个角度看它，都显得大同小异。

sentences.en: It has gardens and pools and different structures carefully arranged around the tomb.
sentences.zh: 它拥有围绕陵墓精心布置的花园、水池和不同的建筑。

sentences.en: There is also a popular myth that they were planning to construct a second building across the river from the Taj Mahal that would have been identical apart from being constructed out of black marble, but I’m not sure how true this myth actually is.
sentences.zh: 还有一个广为流传的传说：他们曾计划在泰姬陵对岸的河边再建造一座建筑，除了采用黑色大理石外，其余都一模一样，但我不知道这个传说究竟有多大真实性。

sentences.en: The Taj Mahal demonstrated the immense wealth and power of the Mughal Empire.
sentences.zh: 泰姬陵展示了莫卧儿帝国巨大的财富和权力。

sentences.en: It required enormous resources and labor.
sentences.zh: 它需要巨大的资源和劳动力。

sentences.en: Thousands of workers and craftsmen participated in the project over many years.
sentences.zh: 数以千计的工人和工匠历时多年参与了这一项目。

sentences.en: By the 20th and 21st centuries, the Taj Mahal had become one of the most internationally recognized landmarks in the world.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪和21世纪，泰姬陵已成为世界上国际知名度最高的标志性建筑之一。

sentences.en: I think it might be India’s strongest cultural symbol, and when I visited, I thought it was spectacular.
sentences.zh: 我认为它可能是印度最强大的文化象征，当我参观时，我觉着它蔚为壮观。

sentences.en: The next wonder on the list, the final one I’m going to talk about today, is Christ the Redeemer.
sentences.zh: 名单上的下一个奇迹，也是我今天要谈论的最后一个，是基督救世主雕像。

sentences.en: Christ the Redeemer is an enormous statue of Jesus Christ overlooking the Brazilian city of Rio de Janeiro.
sentences.zh: 基督救世主雕像是一座俯瞰巴西里约热内卢市的巨大耶稣基督雕像。

sentences.en: And probably it is the most controversial of the choices I’ve talked about today.
sentences.zh: 它可能是我今天谈论的选择中最具争议的一个。

sentences.en: Why controversial? Well, most of the wonders are ancient, mysterious, unique, or incredibly impressive engineering challenges.
sentences.zh: 为什么有争议？好吧，大多数奇迹都是古老的、神秘的、独特的或令人难以置信的宏大工程挑战。

sentences.en: Christ the Redeemer doesn’t really fit with these things.
sentences.zh: 基督救世主雕像实际上并不符合这些特征。

sentences.en: Construction began in the 1920s, and the statue was officially completed in 1931.
sentences.zh: 建造工作始于20世纪20年代，雕像于1931年正式完工。

sentences.en: It’s less than 100 years old, right? It makes it far younger than ancient sites like the Colosseum, or Petra, or the Great Wall of China, and even quite a lot younger than the Taj Mahal or Machu Picchu, which are relatively more recent compared to the other things.
sentences.zh: 它不到100岁对吧？这使得它比罗马帝国斗兽场、佩特拉古城或中国长城等古代遗址年轻得多，甚至比泰姬陵或马丘比丘还要年轻不少，与其他事物相比，它们相对更新近一些。

sentences.en: Brazil has the largest Catholic population in the world, so they wanted a large Christian monument, and placing it in the hills of Rio de Janeiro was a really popular idea.
sentences.zh: 巴西拥有世界上最多的天主教人口，所以他们想要一个大型的基督教纪念碑，将其放置在里约热内卢的山丘上是一个非常受欢迎的主意。

sentences.en: The statue stands on top of Corcovado Mountain, high above Rio, with its arms stretched open wide.
sentences.zh: 雕像矗立在科尔科瓦多山顶，高高俯瞰里约，双臂向两边大大张开。

sentences.en: It’s definitely one of the most iconic statues in the world, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这绝对是世界上最具标志性的雕像之一。

sentences.en: Over time, Christ the Redeemer has become, I guess, the global symbol of Brazil.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，基督救世主雕像已经成为我猜想的巴西全球象征。

sentences.en: You’ll see images of the statue whenever Brazil is mentioned on TV or in tourism adverts.
sentences.zh: 每当电视或旅游广告中提到巴西，你都会看到这座雕像的图像。

sentences.en: And I think it instantly represents Rio de Janeiro and Brazilian culture.
sentences.zh: 我认为它瞬间代表了里约热内卢和巴西文化。

sentences.en: Still, its inclusion on the New Seven Wonders list is controversial.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，它被列入新世界七大奇迹名单仍然是有争议的。

sentences.en: It’s relatively young and, (sorry to all the Brazilians listening), but in my opinion, it’s less impressive than the other monuments and less impressive than some that failed to make the list.
sentences.zh: 它相对年轻，而且（向所有收听的巴西人道歉），但在我看来，它不如其他古迹令人印象深刻，也不如一些未能入选的古迹震撼。

sentences.en: So why did it make the list? The answer is… Brazil.
sentences.zh: 那它为什么能入选？答案是……巴西。

sentences.en: Remember that this list of wonders was chosen by a public vote.
sentences.zh: 记住，这份奇迹名单是通过公众投票选出的。

sentences.en: Well, Brazil, the country, launched a massive campaign to get Brazilian people to vote for Christ the Redeemer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，巴西这个国家发起了一场声势浩大的运动，让巴西人投票给基督救世主雕像。

sentences.en: Brazil’s telecom companies let people call the voting phone lines for free if they were voting for Christ the Redeemer or text for free.
sentences.zh: 巴西的电信公司让投票给基督救世主雕像的人免费拨打投票热线或免费发短信。

sentences.en: Most other countries didn’t do this. It cost money to vote.
sentences.zh: 大多数其他国家没有这样做。投票是需要花钱的。

sentences.en: This meant it was easier for Brazilian people to vote in the competition.
sentences.zh: 这意味着巴西人在这场竞争中投票更容易。

sentences.en: The campaign in Brazil was sponsored by massive Brazilian companies who spent millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 巴西的活动由花费数百万美元的巴西大公司赞助。

sentences.en: There were TV infomercials on Rio’s TV channels.
sentences.zh: 里约的电视频道上有电视购物广告。

sentences.en: People were reminded to vote for Christ the Redeemer when they got on buses, and they were sent text messages telling them how to vote for Christ the Redeemer for free.
sentences.zh: 人们上公交车时被提醒为基督救世主雕像投票，他们还收到短信告诉他们如何免费为基督救世主雕像投票。

sentences.en: In the end, around 10 million Brazilians voted in the poll, and they overwhelmingly voted for Christ the Redeemer.
sentences.zh: 最后，大约有1000万巴西人在民意调查中投票，他们压倒性地投给了基督救世主雕像。

sentences.en: The New7Wonders Foundation never publicly announced how many people voted in the poll, but the suggestions are tens of millions of people.
sentences.zh: 新七大奇迹基金会从未公开宣布民意调查中有多少人投票，但据推测有数千万人。

sentences.en: 10 million Brazilians voting is a very high percentage of all the people who voted in the poll.
sentences.zh: 1000万巴西人投票占了所有参与投票总人数的很高比例。

sentences.en: Perhaps maybe 20%, 30%, 40% of all people who voted in the poll were Brazilian, and they voted overwhelmingly for their national monument.
sentences.zh: 也许所有投票者中20%、30%、40%可能是巴西人，他们压倒性地投给了本国的纪念碑。

sentences.en: Of course, though, not everyone agrees with the results of the New7Wonders project, and from the beginning, it faced criticism and questions over whether it was fair.
sentences.zh: 当然，并非所有人都赞同新七大奇迹项目的评选结果，从一开始，它就面临着关于公平与否的批评和质疑。

sentences.en: One important issue involved the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的问题涉及埃及的吉萨大金字塔。

sentences.en: It’s the only surviving wonder from the original Ancient Seven Wonders list, and it had held legendary status for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 它是最初古代世界七大奇迹中唯一幸存的奇迹，数千年来一直享有传奇地位。

sentences.en: It’s far older than all the other wonders on the list, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它比名单上的所有其他奇迹都要古老得多。

sentences.en: Eventually, the organizers gave the pyramid an honorary position.
sentences.zh: 最终，组织者给了金字塔一个荣誉地位。

sentences.en: Instead of forcing it to compete in the vote, they said that the pyramid was an honorary wonder because it already had that status.
sentences.zh: 他们没有强迫它参与投票，而是说金字塔是一个荣誉奇迹，因为它已经拥有那种地位了。

sentences.en: But if the pyramid was too historically important to compete in the competition, what exactly did winning the New7Wonders title really mean?
sentences.zh: 但如果金字塔因历史重要性太高而无法参与竞争，那么赢得“新七大奇迹”称号究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: Another criticism involved the voting process itself.
sentences.zh: 另一项批评涉及投票过程本身。

sentences.en: The organizers wanted a democratic project.
sentences.zh: 组织者想要一个民主的项目。

sentences.en: They wanted people to vote in the poll. But access to the internet in 2007 was far from equal.
sentences.zh: 他们希望人们在民意调查中投票。但在2007年，互联网的普及远非平等。

sentences.en: This meant that wealthier countries or more connected countries had a better advantage, and countries with huge populations had more potential voters.
sentences.zh: 这意味着较富裕的国家或网络更发达的国家具有更好的优势，而人口大国拥有更多的潜在选民。

sentences.en: It might have been fairer if they did something like… for example, in Europe, they have the big singing competition called the Eurovision, and you’re not allowed to vote for your own country.
sentences.zh: 如果他们采取类似以下的做法可能会更公平……例如，在欧洲，他们有一个名为欧洲歌唱大赛的大型歌唱比赛，规定是不允许为自己的国家投票。

sentences.en: Perhaps it would have been fairer if you were not allowed to vote for your own country’s monument.
sentences.zh: 也许如果不允许为自己国家的古迹投票会更公平一些。

sentences.en: Some governments treated the competition extremely seriously.
sentences.zh: 一些政府对这场竞争极其严肃对待。

sentences.en: There were several countries that had large promotional campaigns encouraging their cities to vote for their national monument.
sentences.zh: 有几个国家开展了大型宣传活动，鼓励其城市为本国古迹投票。

sentences.en: As a result, the competition basically rewarded your ability to get votes rather than the historical or cultural importance And making a list of just seven wonders misses a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 结果，这场比赛基本上奖励的是你拉票的能力，而不是历史或文化重要性。而且仅列出七大奇迹会遗漏很多东西。

sentences.en: Places that missed out include Angkor Wat in Cambodia, the Acropolis of Athens, or Hagia Sophia in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 错失良机的地方包括柬埔寨吴哥窟、雅典卫城或土耳其圣索菲亚大教堂。

sentences.en: There were also concerns about commercialization.
sentences.zh: 人们还对商业化表示担忧。

sentences.en: The New7Wonders Foundation was a private organization, and the voting system was connected to paid telephone services and commercial partnerships.
sentences.zh: 新七大奇迹基金会是一个私人组织，投票系统与付费电话服务和商业合作伙伴关系挂钩。

sentences.en: As I mentioned at the beginning of the episode, many people mistakenly believed UNESCO had organized this campaign because UNESCO is associated with cultural heritage.
sentences.zh: 正如我在节目开头所提到的，许多人错误地认为UNESCO组织了这场活动，因为UNESCO与文化遗产联系在一起。

sentences.en: But UNESCO was not involved at all. The organization argued that cultural heritage should not be decided through voting.
sentences.zh: 但UNESCO根本没有参与。该组织认为文化遗产不应该通过投票来决定。

sentences.en: A monument’s importance does not increase because millions of people vote for it online.
sentences.zh: 一座纪念碑的重要性并不会因为数百万人在线投票而增加。

sentences.en: When people were voting in this competition, were they choosing the greatest monuments in human history, like the idea originally was?
sentences.zh: 当人们在这次比赛中投票时，他们是在选择人类历史上最伟大的古迹，就像最初的构想那样吗？

sentences.en: Or were they just choosing monuments they knew?
sentences.zh: 还是他们只是在选择他们知道的古迹？

sentences.en: They recognized? Were they voting based on greatness or based on other factors?​
sentences.zh: 他们认得的古迹？他们的投票是基于伟大程度还是基于其他因素？

sentences.en: In today’s episode, I have introduced the New Seven Wonders of the World: the Great Wall of China, Petra, Machu Picchu, Chichén Itzá, the Colosseum, the Taj Mahal, and Christ the Redeemer.
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，我介绍了新世界七大奇迹：中国的万里长城、佩特拉、马丘比丘、奇琴伊察、罗马斗兽场、泰姬陵和基督救世主雕像。

sentences.en: I also tried to emphasize how this list was basically a large advertising campaign voted on by people around the world.
sentences.zh: 我也试图强调这个名单基本上是如何变成一场由世界各地人们投票的大型广告活动的。

sentences.en: It’s really difficult to make a list of just seven wonders.
sentences.zh: 要列出一份只有七个奇迹的名单真的很困难。

sentences.en: In fact, I think comparing places like Christ the Redeemer to Petra in Jordan, just doesn’t seem right.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为把像基督救世主雕像这样的地方与约旦的佩特拉进行比较，似乎就不太合适。

sentences.en: This is not to say that Christ the Redeemer is not impressive or not a wonder.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说基督救世主雕像不令人印象深刻或不是奇迹。

sentences.en: It is. It’s an amazing statue. But you’re comparing two different things, right?
sentences.zh: 它是。这是一座令人惊叹的雕像。但你在比较两个不同的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: Petra is a 2,000-year-old ancient city carved into stone.
sentences.zh: 佩特拉是一座雕刻在石头中的2000年历史古城。

sentences.en: Christ the Redeemer is an impressive statue from the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 基督救世主雕像是20世纪令人印象深刻的雕像。

sentences.en: They should be in different categories. Perhaps Christ the Redeemer should be in a modern wonders category, whereas Petra should be in an ancient cities category.
sentences.zh: 它们应该属于不同的类别。也许基督救世主应该属于现代奇迹类别，而佩特拉应该属于古代城市类别。

sentences.en: Comparing cities like Machu Picchu and Petra, to architecture like the Great Wall of China and the Colosseum, to statues like Christ the Redeemer, or pyramids like Chichén Itzá and the Pyramid of Giza.
sentences.zh: 将马丘比丘和佩特拉这样的城市，与中国长城和罗马斗兽场这样的建筑，以及像基督救世主雕像这样的雕像，或是奇琴伊察和吉萨大金字塔这样的金字塔进行比较。

sentences.en: These are all different things. They’re different categories.
sentences.zh: 这些都是不同的东西。它们属于不同的类别。

sentences.en: It’s really hard to compare. But I really want to know what you think.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难比较。但我真的很想知道你的想法。

sentences.en: Which of the New Seven Wonders would you like to visit the most?
sentences.zh: 新世界七大奇迹中你最想参观哪一个？

sentences.en: Did the right monuments win? And what famous place do you think was unfairly left out?
sentences.zh: 获胜的古迹对了吗？你认为哪个著名地方被不公平地漏掉了？

sentences.en: And if you created your own list today, what would be included?
sentences.zh: 如果你今天创建你自己的名单，会有什么被包括在内？
